Use `--no-content` to perform a metadata-only scan before delegating work, ensuring quick validation of project structure without processing file contents.

Use `select-model` to preview the recommended Mistral model for a given task before running actions like `project-scan` or `project-action`.

```powershell
node ~/.codex/skills/mistral-subagent/scripts/mistral-subagent.mjs project-scan --path path/to/project --no-content --max-files 20 --output snapshot.json
```

```powershell
node ~/.codex/skills/mistral-subagent/scripts/mistral-subagent.mjs select-model --task Audit
```
